data.one_liner: Prebuilt, customizable sign‑in/sign‑up UI for Amplify Auth in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides an Authenticator widget that handles the full authentication flow, including sign‑in, sign‑up, password reset, and social sign‑in. It manages session state and offers built‑in autofill support.
use_when: You need a ready‑made authentication UI for Amplify Cognito
You want to reduce boilerplate for auth flows in a Flutter app
You require cross‑platform support (mobile, web, desktop)
avoid_when: You need a completely custom UI design beyond the provided customization options
You are not using Amplify as your backend
weaknesses: Limited to the styling/customization offered by the package
data.setup_notes: Add amplify_auth_cognito, amplify_flutter and amplify_authenticator to pubspec, call Amplify.addPlugin(AmplifyAuthCognito()) and Amplify.configure() before using Authenticator widget.

alternatives.name: amplify_auth_cognito
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer building your own UI on top of the low‑level Cognito plugin

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: When using Firebase as the backend instead of Amplify

alternatives.name: google_sign_in
alternatives.why_pick_it: For simple Google sign‑in without the full Amplify stack
